newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Summers says markets reflect U.S. economy.
newsitem.headline: Summers says markets reflect U.S. economy.

text.p: U.S. deputy Treasury secretary Lawrence Summers said financial markets were reflecting "in some way" changes in the fundamentals of the U.S. economy.
But Summers declined to be more specific at the World Economic Forum here when reporters asked him if the strength of U.S. equity markets was based on the state of the economy.
Summers said private sector changes and declining long-term interest rates linked to the policy environment had caused important shifts in "fundamental features of the American economy".
"It would be appropriate for those kinds of fundamentals to be reflected in some way in the markets," Summers told a news conference.
"But as to commenting on where the market is right now, or the market as a reflection of those fundamentals, that's not something I want to do," he said.
